evidence.section: Discussion
evidence.quote: during compression deformation, the alternating phase structure becomes more heterogeneous, implying that dynamically strengthened heterogeneous structures lead to strong back stress effects

evidence.section: Discussion
evidence.quote: Nb has a larger atomic radius (approximately 145 p.m.), making it prone to displacing the remaining atoms in the lattice, leading to lattice distortion, thus the larger matching elastic modulus of Nb in the HCP phase enhances the solid solution strengthening effect in HCP

evidence.section: Discussion
evidence.quote: heterogeneous phase interfaces contribute significantly to the strength of EHEAs. This is mainly related to the mismatch strengthening effect of shear modulus and lattice parameters, i.e., interface strengthening effects involving dislocation-interface interactions

evidence.section: Discussion
evidence.quote: lattice mismatch between the two phases and the variation in interfacial energy due to the occupation of different lattice positions by atoms are the main reasons for the two different matching modes
